findings.summary: An invalid number draft in fields keeps Apply blocked after switching to the JSON view
findings.scenario: Type 'abc' in Base size, click Edit as JSON: the text shows valid settings but Apply is disabled (and applySettings refuses) until the textarea is edited or Revert is pressed, with the reason only in a tooltip

findings.summary: A draft that reads back equal in value but not in text (1.0 for 1) keeps the settings counted as edited
findings.scenario: Baseline scale 1, type '1.0': settings equal baseline yet fields is non-empty so Apply stays enabled and sends a no-op that makes the host drop and reimport the asset
